children.value: Resting-state fMRI Blood-Oxygen-Level-Dependent (BOLD) signals for 62 cortical regions, organized into functional networks across the left and right hemispheres.
The 17-network organization follows the Yeo et al. (2011) cortical parcellation,
wide, with hierarchical columns — 920 timepoints (rows) x 62 regions (columns).
The columns carry a three-level hierarchical index describing each region; the cells are the measured signal.
the functional brain network a region belongs to (labeled 1–17). Regions in the same network tend to co-activate even at rest.
the specific structural hub within a network. If a network is a subway line, a node is a station on that line.
an fMRI BOLD signal value, a statistical summary of localized neural activity over time.
62 — unique brain regions (network x node x hemisphere).
the BOLD signal in each cell.
